All displayed functions are literal definitions on a finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. fderiv is Frechet derivative; gradient is the inner-product gradient; ContDiff real2 is twice continuous differentiability.
expMeasure1 is the rate-one exponential law on real numbers; infinitePi is its canonical countable product on real sequences. Real.toNNReal is max(x,0) represented as a nonnegative real.

WithTop NNReal includes infinity. hittingAfter is the infimum of nonnegative times entering the target, infinity if no hit exists. untopD0 returns the finite value, default zero at infinity. Sum.inl/inr are distinct Borel tags; Unit has one element; products associate right.

Fin(n+1) indexes integers0 through n. Measurable is Borel measurability for the indicated product/sum spaces. Measure.map is pushforward. The final integral is a Lebesgue integral of an extended nonnegative function restricted to A, without normalization.

Real division is total, with division by zero equal to zero. Interval integrals are Bochner integrals on real intervals. Nat.rec is the displayed finite recursion. ENNReal.ofReal embeds max(x,0) into extended nonnegative reals.
